title: every sieve carries its own why
intention: Every sieve build_inspector registers carries a record under sieves/ with a `why` and a `why_source` naming where the why came from (Akien's words with a quote and an address, a Law, or CC's reading of a named thing); a registered sieve with no why reds; and every finding carries its sieve's why, so the refusal a gate prints has the why the 17.11.6 adjudication reads.
why: Akien 2026-11-13, outline 17.11.6.1: "I designed the tools, but not the specific sieves. you built those to handle what you thought i meant for each inspector. ... i don't know why each sieve is there. we are supposed to add a why to each sieve so we can help adjudicate it." Measured that day: 43 sieves registered, 36 sieves/*.json records carrying name, band and dials but no why; the whys live only in docstrings, which no gate prints.
traces_to: Outline 17.11.6 and 17.11.6.1 (a refusal is adjudicated against the refusing sieve's own why, by CC); 17.11.5 (every intention carries a why); Law 4 (the rule is a sieve, not a convention).
how: Each sieves/<name>.json gains `why` (one or two sentences read from that sieve's docstring) and `why_source`: {kind: akien, quote, at} | {kind: law, law} | {kind: cc_reading, of}. The 8 registered sieves with no record get one, band from the_nest(). runners_leave_trails.json, the one list-shaped file, is runner data rather than a sieve record and moves to cairn/machines/build_inspector/runners_leave_trails.json. A new sieve every_sieve_carries_its_why, on build_inspector's own row, reds a registered sieve with no record or a record that fails the shape, an akien quote that does not appear verbatim (whitespace folded) in that sieve's own source, and a record naming no registered sieve. inspect()'s fire() stamps values.sieve_why on every finding, which the PROVEME refusal already prints (transitions._build_gate renders values), so nothing outside build_inspector changes.

clauses.claim: every sieve in SIEVES has sieves/<name>.json whose name is <name>, with a non-blank why and a why_source of a known kind carrying its fields, and every_sieve_carries_its_why finds nothing over the live tree

over a scratch copy of sieves/, each of: a registered sieve's record removed, a blank why, a why_source of unknown kind or missing its field, an akien quote not in the sieve's source, a Law outside Law 1..10 and RULE 1, and a record for no registered sieve, reds every_sieve_carries_its_why with one finding naming that sieve
a finding returned by inspect() carries values.sieve_why equal to its sieve record's why
the PROVEME build gate's refusal for a red component carries the refusing sieve's why
sieves/ holds exactly one record per registered sieve, and a_run_that_fails_to_run_leaves_a_trail reads its runner rows from cairn/machines/build_inspector/runners_leave_trails.json

decisions.text: D1: every sieves/<name>.json gains why and why_source, each why read from that sieve's docstring; the 8 missing records are written with bands from the_nest().
D2: runners_leave_trails.json moves out of sieves/ to cairn/machines/build_inspector/runners_leave_trails.json, and _RUNNERS_FILE follows it.
D3: the sieve every_sieve_carries_its_why, registered in SIEVES and scoped to build_inspector's own row; its own record carries its why.
D4: fire() in inspect() stamps values.sieve_why on every finding from the sieve's record.
D5: the proof, one tooth per falsifier clause, over the live records and a scratch copy of sieves/.

out: the content quality of any why (17.11.6: sieves never weigh a why)

measured.saw: 43 sieves in SIEVES; 36 files in sieves/; 8 registered with no record (claim_propagates_with_provenance, every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin, every_exemption_cites_a_ruling_or_an_impossibility, green_seal_names_a_tooth, intention_fidelity, no_iou_stands, question_links_agree, sole_path_admissions_are_entered); 1 file not a sieve (runners_leave_trails.json, a list)
measured.how: python: set(SIEVES) against sieves/*.json stems on cairn e94931805

measured.saw: every record's keys are band, band_name, dials, name; every dials is {}
